conditions.condition: Navigator is in a GRILL_ME conversation on retry behavior
conditions.where: history turns 1-4: '/navigator Grill me on how retries work…', with GRILL_ME announced

conditions.condition: A user style (tony) was explicitly selected earlier in the conversation
conditions.where: history user turn 1 'Use user style tony.'; .standards/user-styles/navigator/tony.md

conditions.condition: At least one quiz question was answered and graded, and a later question is pending
conditions.where: history: the 503 question is answered and graded; the 404 question is pending in the last assistant turn

conditions.condition: Earlier feedback cites real code evidence for the retry topic
conditions.where: src/retry.js:1,4,16 and src/client.js:10-13,18 match the history citations; the 100/200/400 ms waits match backoffDelay

conditions.condition: The discovery helper is available and its catalog includes INVESTIGATE
The style inventory offers an alternative style, so inferring a substitute would be observable
Retry behavior in code matches tests

summary: The history establishes a GRILL_ME conversation on retry behavior. Style tony is selected, one question is answered, and one is pending. Every line citation matches src/retry.js and src/client.js, and the helper's catalog includes INVESTIGATE and both styles. The checks are safe necessary conditions: the reply must mention 'investigate', no files may change, WorkflowState and tony.md must be unchanged, and the judgment is left to the judge. The Navigator invariants are correct.
